name: After § 18
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the joint communication on humanitarian aid (JOIN(2026)0025)
part_text: 18b. Calls on the Commission, the EEAS and the Member States to pay particular attention to the protection of persecuted religious minorities, especially Christian communities in regions affected by conflict, instability or religious extremism, and to ensure that humanitarian assistance reaches vulnerable groups facing discrimination, violence or forced displacement on the basis of their faith;
